beats.say: Katie Boulter has swept straight into the Japan Open quarter-finals in Osaka.
Sky Sports reports she defeated Viktorija Golubic in straight sets to advance.
The Leicestershire star originally started playing tennis when she was aged five.
She was born in Woodhouse Eaves on 1 August 1996.
Today, she proudly stands as the current British number two in women's singles.
Can Katie Boulter go all the way and lift the trophy in Japan?
